title: Avomi FLIQ Prefilled Vape Pods - Menthol
description: The Avomi Fliq 4-in-1 Replacement Prefilled Pods in Menthol deliver a crisp and invigorating menthol experience for vapers who enjoy a cool, refreshing vape. This menthol flavour provides a soothing, frosty sensation with each puff, ideal for a revitalising vaping experience. Each pod is prefilled with 2ml of 20mg nicotine salt e-liquid, ensuring a smooth and satisfying throat hit. Designed for ease and versatility, the Avomi Fliq 4-in-1 Prefilled Pod Device allows users to swap between four flavours on the go. These replacement pods are a hassle-free solution for quick flavour changes, making the device convenient and adaptable for any vaper’s preference. The Avomi Fliq 4-in-1 Device features a 950mAh rechargeable battery with USB-C fast charging, providing extended usage and a reliable vaping experience. With an ergonomic and soft-touch design, this pod system is comfortable to hold and easy to carry wherever you go.
